name: Seijin Byoutou
source:
It's been a few months since I was assigned to this hospital as the internal medicine doctor. When the doctors have left and the inpatients are fast asleep, I work as the on-call doctor.
The patients are forced into a deep sleep with powerful sedatives and do not wake up until morning. Tonight, I went out hunting in the ward again...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227145/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
我作为内科主治医生被调到这家医院已有几个月了。每当其他医生下班离开、住院患者们熟睡之际，我便作为值班医生开始工作。
患者们被强效镇静剂强行送入深眠，直到天亮都不会醒来。今晚，我又一次在病房里展开了狩猎……

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227145/]Getchu[/url]]
